```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Prepare standalone OncodriveCLUSTL input for pILC WES
#
# Inputs:
#   1. Tier-1 common combined MAF
#   2. Existing GRCh38 coding-region file used for OncodriveFML
#
# Outputs:
#   1. SNV-only mutation TSV required by OncodriveCLUSTL
#   2. Dedicated OncodriveCLUSTL coding-region TSV
#   3. QC tables and an input-preparation manifest
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

base_dir <- paste0(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/",
  "PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON"
)

maf_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/",
  "Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"
)

# Reuse the validated GRCh38 CDS coordinates prepared for FML,
# but write a separate CLUSTL-compatible copy with only the
# required columns and a dedicated QC step.
fml_regions_file <- paste0(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/tools/OncodriveFML/",
  "resources/GRCh38/regions/cds.regions.gz"
)

clustl_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "OncodriveCLUSTL")
input_dir <- file.path(clustl_dir, "input")
reference_dir <- file.path(clustl_dir, "reference")
results_dir <- file.path(clustl_dir, "results")
logs_dir <- file.path(clustl_dir, "logs")

for (d in c(input_dir, reference_dir, results_dir, logs_dir)) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

stopifnot(file.exists(maf_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(fml_regions_file))

message("Input MAF: ", maf_file)
message("Source coding regions: ", fml_regions_file)
message("OncodriveCLUSTL directory: ", clustl_dir)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Read MAF
# ------------------------------------------------------------

maf <- fread(
  maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = "Hugo_Symbol",
  data.table = TRUE,
  showProgress = TRUE
)

message("Total MAF rows: ", nrow(maf))

required_maf_cols <- c(
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Chromosome",
  "Start_Position",
  "Reference_Allele",
  "Tumor_Seq_Allele2",
  "Variant_Classification"
)

missing_maf_cols <- setdiff(required_maf_cols, names(maf))

if (length(missing_maf_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required MAF columns: ",
    paste(missing_maf_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Keep coding SNV classes
# ------------------------------------------------------------
#
# OncodriveCLUSTL tests nucleotide-position clustering and accepts
# substitutions only. Silent SNVs are retained because they are valid
# observed substitutions and can contribute to clustering/background.
# Indels, MNVs, and complex variants are excluded explicitly.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

coding_snv_classes <- c(
  "Silent",
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Splice_Region",
  "Translation_Start_Site"
)

maf_coding <- maf[
  Variant_Classification %in% coding_snv_classes
]

message(
  "Rows after coding-classification filter: ",
  nrow(maf_coding)
)

clustl_input <- maf_coding[
  ,
  .(
    CHROMOSOME = as.character(Chromosome),
    POSITION   = as.integer(Start_Position),
    REF        = toupper(as.character(Reference_Allele)),
    ALT        = toupper(as.character(Tumor_Seq_Allele2)),
    SAMPLE     = as.character(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
  )
]

clustl_input[
  ,
  CHROMOSOME := gsub(
    "^chr",
    "",
    CHROMOSOME,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
]

standard_chromosomes <- c(as.character(1:22), "X", "Y")

clustl_input <- clustl_input[
  CHROMOSOME %in% standard_chromosomes &
  !is.na(POSITION) &
  POSITION > 0 &
  !is.na(REF) &
  !is.na(ALT) &
  !is.na(SAMPLE) &
  SAMPLE != ""
]

# Strict SNV definition: one A/C/G/T reference base and one
# different A/C/G/T alternate base.
clustl_input <- clustl_input[
  grepl("^[ACGT]$", REF) &
  grepl("^[ACGT]$", ALT) &
  REF != ALT
]

# Remove duplicate records while retaining the same mutation when
# it occurs in different samples.
clustl_input <- unique(clustl_input)

setorder(
  clustl_input,
  CHROMOSOME,
  POSITION,
  REF,
  ALT,
  SAMPLE
)

if (nrow(clustl_input) == 0) {
  stop("No valid coding SNVs remained after filtering.")
}

message("Final OncodriveCLUSTL SNV rows: ", nrow(clustl_input))
message("Number of samples: ", uniqueN(clustl_input$SAMPLE))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save the SNV-only mutation input
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clustl_input_file <- file.path(
  input_dir,
  "pILC_WES_oncodriveclustl_SNV.tsv"
)

fwrite(
  clustl_input,
  clustl_input_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = "NA"
)

system2(
  command = "gzip",
  args = c("-kf", shQuote(clustl_input_file))
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare the CLUSTL coding-region file
# ------------------------------------------------------------
#
# OncodriveCLUSTL requires at least:
#   CHROMOSOME, START, END, ELEMENT, SYMBOL
# STRAND is optional but retained here.
#
# The coordinates are copied without coordinate conversion from
# the existing validated GRCh38 CDS file. Multiple exon rows for
# one SYMBOL + ELEMENT are retained and later analyzed with the
# --concatenate option.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

regions_raw <- fread(
  fml_regions_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  showProgress = TRUE
)

required_region_cols <- c(
  "CHROMOSOME",
  "START",
  "END",
  "ELEMENT",
  "SYMBOL"
)

missing_region_cols <- setdiff(required_region_cols, names(regions_raw))

if (length(missing_region_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required coding-region columns: ",
    paste(missing_region_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (!"STRAND" %in% names(regions_raw)) {
  regions_raw[, STRAND := "+"]
}

clustl_regions <- regions_raw[
  ,
  .(
    CHROMOSOME = as.character(CHROMOSOME),
    START      = as.integer(START),
    END        = as.integer(END),
    ELEMENT    = as.character(ELEMENT),
    SYMBOL     = as.character(SYMBOL),
    STRAND     = as.character(STRAND)
  )
]

clustl_regions[
  ,
  CHROMOSOME := gsub(
    "^chr",
    "",
    CHROMOSOME,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
]

clustl_regions <- clustl_regions[
  CHROMOSOME %in% standard_chromosomes &
  !is.na(START) &
  !is.na(END) &
  START > 0 &
  END > START &
  !is.na(ELEMENT) &
  ELEMENT != "" &
  !is.na(SYMBOL) &
  SYMBOL != "" &
  STRAND %in% c("+", "-")
]

clustl_regions <- unique(clustl_regions)

setorder(
  clustl_regions,
  CHROMOSOME,
  SYMBOL,
  ELEMENT,
  START,
  END
)

if (nrow(clustl_regions) == 0) {
  stop("No valid GRCh38 coding regions remained after filtering.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Region consistency checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

region_identity_qc <- clustl_regions[
  ,
  .(
    N_chromosomes = uniqueN(CHROMOSOME),
    N_strands = uniqueN(STRAND),
    N_segments = .N
  ),
  by = .(SYMBOL, ELEMENT)
]

bad_identity <- region_identity_qc[
  N_chromosomes != 1 | N_strands != 1
]

if (nrow(bad_identity) > 0) {
  fwrite(
    bad_identity,
    file.path(results_dir, "QC_invalid_region_identity.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  stop(
    "At least one SYMBOL + ELEMENT maps to multiple chromosomes or strands. ",
    "See QC_invalid_region_identity.tsv"
  )
}

# OncodriveCLUSTL requires segments belonging to the same genomic
# element not to overlap. Adjacent segments are allowed.
clustl_regions[
  ,
  PREVIOUS_MAX_END := shift(cummax(END)),
  by = .(CHROMOSOME, SYMBOL, ELEMENT)
]

region_overlaps <- clustl_regions[
  !is.na(PREVIOUS_MAX_END) & START <= PREVIOUS_MAX_END
]

if (nrow(region_overlaps) > 0) {
  fwrite(
    region_overlaps,
    file.path(results_dir, "QC_overlapping_regions_within_element.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  stop(
    "Overlapping coding segments were detected within at least one ",
    "SYMBOL + ELEMENT. See QC_overlapping_regions_within_element.tsv"
  )
}

clustl_regions[, PREVIOUS_MAX_END := NULL]

clustl_regions_file <- file.path(
  reference_dir,
  "cds_hg38_oncodriveclustl.tsv"
)

fwrite(
  clustl_regions,
  clustl_regions_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = "NA"
)

system2(
  command = "gzip",
  args = c("-kf", shQuote(clustl_regions_file))
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# QC tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qc_sample_burden <- clustl_input[
  ,
  .(SNV_count = .N),
  by = SAMPLE
][order(-SNV_count)]

fwrite(
  qc_sample_burden,
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "QC_SNV_count_per_sample_used_for_OncodriveCLUSTL.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)

qc_variant_class <- maf_coding[
  grepl("^[ACGT]$", toupper(as.character(Reference_Allele))) &
  grepl("^[ACGT]$", toupper(as.character(Tumor_Seq_Allele2))) &
  toupper(as.character(Reference_Allele)) !=
    toupper(as.character(Tumor_Seq_Allele2)),
  .(SNV_count = .N),
  by = Variant_Classification
][order(-SNV_count)]

fwrite(
  qc_variant_class,
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "QC_variant_class_counts_used_for_OncodriveCLUSTL.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)

qc_regions <- clustl_regions[
  ,
  .(
    Segment_count = .N,
    Total_CDS_bp = sum(END - START + 1L)
  ),
  by = .(SYMBOL, ELEMENT)
][order(-Segment_count)]

fwrite(
  qc_regions,
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "QC_coding_regions_used_for_OncodriveCLUSTL.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Manifest
# ------------------------------------------------------------

manifest_file <- file.path(
  results_dir,
  "OncodriveCLUSTL_input_preparation_manifest.txt"
)

writeLines(
  c(
    paste0("Preparation date: ", Sys.time()),
    paste0("Input MAF: ", maf_file),
    paste0("Source coding regions: ", fml_regions_file),
    paste0("Mutation output: ", clustl_input_file, ".gz"),
    paste0("Region output: ", clustl_regions_file, ".gz"),
    paste0("Final coding SNVs: ", nrow(clustl_input)),
    paste0("Samples: ", uniqueN(clustl_input$SAMPLE)),
    paste0("Coding-region rows: ", nrow(clustl_regions)),
    paste0(
      "Unique SYMBOL + ELEMENT combinations: ",
      uniqueN(clustl_regions[, paste(SYMBOL, ELEMENT, sep = "//")])
    ),
    "Genome build: GRCh38/hg38",
    "Mutation types: SNVs only",
    "Coordinate transformation: none",
    "Planned CLUSTL mode: region_restricted + concatenate",
    "Planned signature calculation: region_normalized"
  ),
  con = manifest_file
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Final validation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(file.exists(paste0(clustl_input_file, ".gz")))
stopifnot(file.exists(paste0(clustl_regions_file, ".gz")))

system2("gzip", c("-t", shQuote(paste0(clustl_input_file, ".gz"))))
system2("gzip", c("-t", shQuote(paste0(clustl_regions_file, ".gz"))))

message("OncodriveCLUSTL input preparation completed.")
message("Mutation input: ", paste0(clustl_input_file, ".gz"))
message("Region input: ", paste0(clustl_regions_file, ".gz"))

print(qc_sample_burden)
print(qc_variant_class)
```
